name: Germany
note: Inventions with a recorded country of origin in Wikidata, topped up from the English Wikipedia's per-country invention list articles (CC BY-SA). Every entry passed a Wikidata class check (device, technology, process, product, software, medication ...); diseases, species, discoveries, theorems and food are excluded by ruling. Dates are recorded or parsed from prose and are often approximate.

inventions.name: Chinese checkers
inventions.description: Chinese checkers (US) or Chinese chequers (UK), known as Sternhalma in German, is a strategy board game of German origin that can be played by two, three, four, or six people, playing individually or with partners.

image.author: The original uploader was Splattne at German Wikipedia.

inventions.name: Western concert flute
inventions.description: The Western concert flute can refer to the common C concert flute or to the family of transverse (side-blown) flutes to which the C flute belongs.

inventions.name: Raytheon Lectron
inventions.description: Lectron was a modular electronic experimentation kit designed to introduce youth to basic electronic circuits and theory.

inventions.name: Nitrocellulose
inventions.description: Nitrocellulose is a highly flammable compound formed by nitrating cellulose through exposure to a mixture of nitric acid and sulfuric acid.

inventions.name: Tollens' reagent
inventions.description: Tollens' reagent is a chemical reagent used to distinguish between aldehydes and ketones along with some alpha-hydroxy ketones which can tautomerize into aldehydes.

inventions.name: Decaffeination
inventions.description: Decaffeination is the removal of caffeine from coffee beans, cocoa, tea leaves, and other caffeine-containing materials.

inventions.name: Breaker (hydraulic)
inventions.description: A breaker is a powerful percussion hammer fitted to an excavator for demolishing hard structures.

inventions.name: Glue stick
inventions.description: Glue sticks are solid and hard adhesives in twist or push-up tubes often used for arts and crafts.

inventions.name: Hydromorphone
inventions.description: Hydromorphone, also known as dihydromorphinone, and sold under the brand name Dilaudid among others, is a morphinan opioid used to treat moderate to severe pain.

inventions.name: Dreyse needle gun
inventions.description: The Dreyse needle-gun was a 19th-century military breech-loading rifle, as well as the first breech-loading rifle to use a bolt action to open and close the chamber.

inventions.name: Ballistic missile
inventions.description: A ballistic missile is a type of missile that follows a ballistic trajectory and is powered only during a relatively brief initial period—most of the flight is unpowered.

inventions.name: Magnetometer
inventions.description: A magnetometer is a device that measures magnetic field or magnetic dipole moment.
